build_PCKAccuracy: build a PCKAccuracy metric to evaluate 2D keypoint pose estimation with bbox normalization
build_MpiiPCKAccuracy: build a MpiiPCKAccuracy metric to evaluate MPII dataset pose estimation with head size normalization
build_JhmdbPCKAccuracy: build a JhmdbPCKAccuracy metric to evaluate JHMDB dataset pose estimation with bbox and torso normalization
build_AUC: build an AUC metric to calculate area under curve of keypoint PCK accuracy
build_EPE: build an EPE metric to calculate end-point error of predicted keypoints
